text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the paddock before the Hyacinth Stakes, Agnes Digital is watching the other Umamusume intensely.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
choice_data_list: All right, keep your cleats on.
All right, keep your cleats on.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm fine today! I mean, I'm always fine! I wouldn't let myself lose control.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But do you feel it, Trainer? Something's weird today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume are as darling as ever… Wait. Maybe that's it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Their presence is… even more radiant than ever today…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Look at how serious everyone is before the race. It's to die for. Although I get the feeling I shouldn't put it like that…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's like… beneath their grace lies something even more pure…
choice_data_list: Something… you're hoping to feel firsthand?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nononononono! Don't be ridiculous! I would never be so presumptuous.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No. Today, I only wish to behold it—the true essence of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I won't get involved, of course. A responsible simp admires quietly and without touching!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: However… I can admire them from a better angle than before—from as close as I can get.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As always, she talks as if she's just here to spectate the race. But I can tell by her eyes that she's taking this a little more seriously than usual.
